lines: In this Great Revolution of the people, internal enemies of the state continue their attempts to spoil the minds of our nation's children.
Reports of revolutionary documents being distributed within locations such as Lovro Square and Redwall Street in Verehn raise alarm about what our children could be reading.
We, adults, must come together and protect this nation's education for future generations and stop the spread of Spoilage amongst us.
Aijinkova has probably gone further than any other nation in the world in practicing educational democracy.
It is because of educational democracy that we were able to overthrow our monarchist masters under Svetka's tutelage.
We cannot give up now and allow these predators aligned with our foreign enemies to infect the youths of our nation with Spoilage.
